title: Recent papers (2021 to 2026) relevant to Topologic Studio
selection: From 17 OpenAlex queries (see queries.json), 1278 unique works were pooled; candidates were pre-scored by keyword relevance to Studio's facets, 93 abstracts were read, and 32 papers were selected for relevance to an IFC-native, browser-based, time-dependent, tenability-aware and verified egress tool. Papers without an available abstract are included only where the title alone shows high relevance, and are marked unassessed.

verification.method: Each DOI was resolved at https://api.crossref.org/works/<doi> without any mailto or email parameter. Titles were compared after lower-casing and removing punctuation (similarity of at least 0.90 required); years were compared with Crossref's issued, print and online years. Where the OpenAlex year (online first) differed from Crossref's issued year, the Crossref year is listed and the difference noted.
verification.abstract_sources: OpenAlex abstract_inverted_index; the Crossref abstract field (none of the missing ones had it); the Semantic Scholar Graph API for the ten missing (one recovered).

fields.method: What the paper does, paraphrased from its abstract.
fields.data: Data or cases used, from the abstract.
fields.stated_limitations_future_work: Limitations or future work stated in the abstract; otherwise it says that none is stated.
fields.narrows_gaps: Gap identifiers from gap-matrix.json that the paper narrows.
fields.leaves_open: What the paper leaves open relative to Studio's problem (analyst's reading).
fields.analyst_note: Observations that are the analyst's, not the paper's.

papers.title: Semantics-based connectivity graph for indoor pathfinding powered by IFC-Graph
papers.method: Builds a navigable indoor connectivity graph from IFC semantics (IFC-Graph, a graph form of IFC from a prior study) instead of geometry processing; supports space-to-space, space-to-exit and space-to-facility pathfinding; adds a custom entity, IfcRelConnectsSpace, for vertical connectivity.
papers.data: Real-world IFC building models.
papers.stated_limitations_future_work: No limitation or future work is stated in the abstract.
leaves_open: No metric walkable geometry or distance error; no hazard or time; no shared benchmark (LG5).
papers.analyst_note: The need for a custom IFC entity for vertical links shows that standard IFC relationships were not sufficient for the authors' purpose.

papers.method: Feasibility study of IFC-based means-of-egress checking in Solibri against SBC 201-CR-2024: clauses decomposed into computable variables, model validated for semantic and topological readiness, checked with the SOL/179 Escape Route Analysis template.
